main.description: Registers a push endpoint for the requesting user's device. Web Push requires endpoint, p256dh, and auth. FCM requires token.

provider.description: The push provider to register with.

endpoint.description: The Web Push subscription endpoint. Required when provider is webpush.

p256dh.description: The Web Push subscription's p256dh key. Required when provider is webpush.

auth.description: The Web Push subscription's auth secret. Required when provider is webpush.

token.description: The FCM registration token. Required when provider is fcm.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The request has no valid service auth.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The fields required for the given provider are missing or malformed.

errors.name: PushNotConfigured
errors.description: This AppView has no keypair for the requested provider.
